offering_description.value: Sprinklr sells cloud software to enterprises and public agencies for customer service, social media management, consumer insights and digital marketing. It delivers these tools through a shared platform that brings together customer interactions and data from social networks, messaging, voice and other channels.

primary_products.value: Contact center and customer service software; social media management software; social listening and consumer insights software; digital marketing and advertising management software

primary_services.value: Software implementation and integration; consulting; training; managed services

customer_segment.value: B2B: Enterprise customer service, marketing, communications and consumer research teams; B2G: Government agency communications and public engagement teams

end_markets.value: Retail and consumer goods; financial services; technology and telecommunications; travel and hospitality; public sector

revenue_model.value: subscription: Access to cloud software modules for customer service, social media, consumer insights and marketing; service fees: Implementation, integration, training and managed services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Combines customer interactions and social data in software for enterprise and government teams; service provider: Configures software and integrates customer systems for organizations deploying the platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Customer service, social media management, consumer insights and digital marketing on a shared platform

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise account teams selling cloud subscriptions and professional services; partners / resellers: Consultancies, systems integrators and technology partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Customer data processing subject to privacy rules such as the EU GDPR and California CCPA
